announcements.headline: Restoration of Listing
announcements.insight: Following the September leadership change and delayed accounts, restoration of listing signals a return to normal trading status after recent governance disruptions.

announcements.headline: Publication of Financial Statements on the NSM
announcements.insight: Annual Financial Statements were published in October, following a leadership change in September and a delay to their release in September.

announcements.headline: Publication of Annual Financial Statements
announcements.insight: Annual financial statements are published following a September leadership change. Shareholders should review the results for strategic direction.

announcements.headline: Leadership change at Notting Hill Genesis Group
announcements.insight: Leadership change follows a trading update and delayed accounts. Shareholders should watch for details on how this affects the upcoming audited accounts publication.

announcements.headline: Delay to publication of audited accounts
announcements.insight: Notting Hill Genesis delays its audited accounts following the July trading update. Shareholders should await the finalised figures to assess full-year performance.

announcements.headline: Unaudited trading update for the FYE 31 March 2026
announcements.insight: Notting Hill Genesis has issued an unaudited trading update for the year ending 31 March 2026. Shareholders should await further details to assess financial performance.
